name: CVAT
description: Computer vision annotation tool for labeling images and video for object detection and segmentation models.

envVars.description: Password for the initial CVAT superuser account
Password for the CVAT Postgres database

composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      CVAT_POSTGRES_HOST: "{{serviceName}}-postgres"
      CVAT_REDIS_HOST: "{{serviceName}}-redis"
      CVAT_ADMIN_PASSWORD: {{env.CVAT_ADMIN_PASSWORD}}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/data:/home/django/data
      - {{appDataPath}}/logs:/home/django/logs
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-postgres
      - {{serviceName}}-redis
  {{serviceName}}-postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: cvat
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      POSTGRES_DB: cvat
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
  {{serviceName}}-redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-redis
    restart: unless-stopped
  {{serviceName}}-ui:
    image: cvat/ui:latest
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-ui
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      CVAT_UI_HOST: localhost
